mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (student_no, nickname, password, phone, avatar, points, status, create_time) VALUES (#{studentNo}, #{nickname}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{avatar}, #{points}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE sys_user SET points = #{points} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS newUsers FROM sys_user WHERE DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
